label: project-default
copyGuidance: Mark reusable text with data-rich-copy on its section: each review finding includes its title, file location, explanation and suggested fix; prompts and rewritten text contain only the requested output. Code in pre elements gets a copy action automatically. Mark an inline raster img, or its figure, with data-rich-copy="image" to copy the image. Keep a little room at the upper right for the hover/focus copy icon; do not add your own copy buttons or clipboard scripts. Use data-rich-copy-ignore for decorations or line numbers and data-rich-copy="off" to disable copying within a region. Preserve ordinary text selection. Copying is local and does not submit an Agent action.
